summary: NetClass Technology Inc filed a Form 6-K disclosing two technical development service agreements entered on May 6, 2026. The company issued 2,800,000 Class A ordinary shares to Bangyuan Liu and 3,200,000 Class A ordinary shares to Akaewood Investment Holding Co., Ltd. as consideration for twelve months of technical development services for its LLM-Based Learning APP System and AI-based technology R&D services. The shares were issued as restricted securities under Regulation S. This is a routine service-for-shares arrangement, not a special-situation event; no tender offer, acquisition, or restructuring mechanics are involved.
